engine: Saisei's text+image SECTION reveal (S6) — as the section scrolls into view, each element RISES from under a bottom mask: a vertical portrait photo grows up like a column on the LEFT, and the body copy on the RIGHT reveals LINE BY LINE. Axis Y (bottom->top), scroll-driven, asymmetric — the OPPOSITE engine to center-seam-split (X, centre-out, timeline). Harvested from D_saisei (S6 / project INFO section).

measured_teardown.move: every [data-rise] element starts clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0) (clipped from the bottom) + translateY(12px) + scale(1.04) + opacity 0; on scroll-into-view animates to inset(0)/0/1/1, power3.out. Body text splits into masked lines (overflow:hidden + line translateY 100%->0), ~40ms per-line stagger.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei /project INFO section (v4 x_008-x_036): cream section rises from under the dark hero; left portrait photo grows up as a column; right body reveals line-by-line bottom->top; same primitive repeats for the next media.

riseSelector.what: elements that rise as a whole (photo, eyebrow, h2, meta).

lineSelector.what: containers whose TEXT is split into masked lines and revealed per-line.

duration.what: rise duration per element / per line.

entry: ScrollClipRise.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, play(), hide(), destroy }. On scroll-into-view it rises every [data-rise] element from under a bottom mask and reveals [data-rise-lines] text per masked line. play() runs it manually; hide() resets.
law: Lenis -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger; clip-path inset(bottom) + transform(translateY, scale) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL; reduced-motion / <=820px -> shown. The hidden state is set THROUGH gsap (gsap.set) so gsap owns the transform channel — else gsap.to({y:0}) doesn't know the 12px/110% start and the elements stall mid-rise. owns_pin false.
gate_mode: media is an clipped from the bottom during the rise — the smoothness-gate reads the clipped frames as 'blank' (the photo is intentionally cut while rising), a false positive (same class as F-39). Verify fps/jank directly (the gate still reports those): the rise is smooth, the photo is full after reveal.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO section — photo column grows up on the left (clip inset(100%->0)), eyebrow + serif h2 rise, body copy reveals per masked line (4 lines, ~40ms stagger), all power3.out, on scroll-into-view. Verified: hidden state set via gsap.set (lines reach translateY 0, no stall — a bug caught and fixed). Cream washi #f1ebd6 / ink #2a2418 (Saisei palette). Gate fps 59.9, jank 1/713 (0.1%); blank% is the clipped-img false positive.
